recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned photographic composition featuring three men in formal suits walking away from a vintage propeller airplane, framed by heavy black borders and bold, overlapping serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The large-scale typography overlaps the top edge of the central image frame.
The sepia/yellow color cast of the photo contrasts against the stark black and white of the layout.
The diagonal lines of the aircraft wings lead the eye down to the subjects.
coreInvariants: Heavy black top and bottom letterbox borders
Tight, overlapping letter spacing in the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in the lower third, mid-ground; vintage aircraft dominates the upper two-thirds of the image frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white serif text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: from the bold header, down the aircraft's nose, to the three walking figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the aircraft and subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with limited palette; saturation is low, leaning into a monochromatic yellow-scale.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing character overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a large, circular tittle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold lowercase serif paired with small, tracked-out uppercase serif.
graphicDevices: Thin vertical divider lines at the bottom edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Provides the elegant, high-fashion editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned, high-contrast photograph of three men in dark suits carrying suitcases, walking away from a vintage twin-engine propeller plane on a sunny tarmac. Place this image inside a central square frame with thick black bars at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white lowercase serif text across the top black bar, allowing the descenders to overlap into the photo. Add a smaller uppercase serif subtitle in yellow to the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the photo restricted to a yellow/sepia and black palette?
Does the text overlap the image frame?
Are there thick black borders at the top and bottom?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the photo
mustRedesign: Any brand logos in the bottom black bar
Specific aircraft tail numbers or markings
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'i' tittle is a perfect circle.
Ensure the yellow tone is consistent across the entire photo.
Verify the black borders are solid and matte.
Confirm the subjects are wearing formal suits.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast vintage photo, apply a monochromatic yellow tint, frame it with thick black letterboxing, and overlay bold, tightly-kerned serif typography that breaks the frame edge.
